info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Birch Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Birch Notebook Detail Management API allows businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed information about birch notebooks in their product catalog. This API facilitates the submission of comprehensive product specifications, including features, dimensions, and pricing. It is particularly useful for retailers and manufacturers seeking to enhance their product visibility and streamline inventory management. Developers can integrate this API to automate the addition of new product details into their existing catalog systems, ensuring that customers have access to the latest information.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed entries for the Birch Notebook. It is designed for users to submit comprehensive information tailored to their specific needs in documenting or organizing content within the Birch Notebook framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Birch notebook. It should contain all required fields in the specified JSON format to successfully create or update notebook details.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details retrieved.

CreateCatalogBirchNotebookDetailRequest.title: Birch Notebook Request

birch_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Birch notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Birch notebooks requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Birch notebook.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Birch notebook.
